gui.gnfrontier.guide.0:
Scavenging
Search homes and drawers for food and cloth. Dismantle wrecks with a pickaxe; a Create wrench recovers extra iron, aluminum and wiring. Make rough iron tools before building industry. Change the window-kick key under GN Frontier in Controls.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.1:
Industry and military clearance
Use Create and TFMG to make steel, receivers and chromoly steel. Military deliveries unlock clearance II at 25 reputation and III at 60. Each gun or vehicle recipe consumes one manufacturing permit from the PDA. Found weapons remain usable regardless of clearance.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.2:
Vehicle trading
LAV-150, BMP-2, M1A2 and AH-6 offers contain complete Superb Warfare vehicles. Only factory-condition containers can be sold. Recovered vehicles carrying cargo or individual data cannot be sold as-is.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.3:
Mining income
Right-click the rig with a CPU and GPU, then supply power. Pentium and 8800 GTX consume 50 FE/t and earn $2 per 60 seconds. i5 and GTX 480 consume 90 FE/t and earn $4 per 20 seconds. Income goes to the owner. Work stops without power.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.4:
Satellite link
Place the launcher under open sky in an Ad Astra dimension. Insert a satellite, one steel engine and two buckets of TFMG diesel, then supply 160 FE/t. After launch, power the owner's ground station with 20 FE/t to bypass PDA jamming.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.5:
Strategic deterrence
Insert the controller into the station and supply 80 FE/t. It suppresses reinforcements and military encounters targeting its owner, and clears Simple Enemy soldiers' targeting. The effect expires shortly after power loss or chunk unloading.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.6:
Project Noah
Deploy the terraformer on Mars or Glacio with a seed and 80 FE/t. After atmospheric conversion, it restores grass, flowers and saplings within 64m. Each surface column costs 100 FE, up to four per tick. Buildings and protected areas are avoided; unloaded chunks pause work.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.7:
Hypoxia
Prolonged lack of air underwater causes unconsciousness, disabling movement, attacks and the PDA. Recover for five seconds where you can breathe to stand again. Drowning damage continues, so prepare breathing equipment and an escape route before diving.

gui.gnfrontier.title.tagline: From the ruins, beyond the stars.
gui.gnfrontier.title.world:
Explore the city. Reclaim its resources.
Take the next step beyond a lost world.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.0.title: Explore and salvage
gui.gnfrontier.guide.0.body:
Search the city for food, medicine and materials. Supported loot containers keep separate contents for each player.

Use a pickaxe to salvage cars. Breaking them with a Create wrench yields more materials.

You lose carried items on death. Store important supplies before heading out.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.1.title: Your first workshop
gui.gnfrontier.guide.1.body:
Make a crafting table in your 2 by 2 inventory grid: two rough iron ingots on top, two planks below.

Ordinary furnaces cannot be used. Recover materials and begin industry with Create machinery.

Use the item browser to look up recipes.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.2.title: Beds and respawning
gui.gnfrontier.guide.2.body:
Sleeping and skipping the night are disabled. Beds register your respawn point.

The first registration is immediate. Changing to another bed requires three in-game days after registration.

The initial spawn and a valid registered bed protect a five-block area. The bed itself can still be destroyed by enemies.
gui.gnfrontier.guide.3.title: PDA and daily missions
gui.gnfrontier.guide.3.body:
Use the PDA to trade and accept missions. For delivery missions, gather the requested items and quantities before claiming the reward.

Daily missions refresh according to elapsed world time. Check the remaining time shown on the PDA.

Your standing with factions and merchants affects available trades.

gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.0: Exploration: Homes can hold food and cloth; offices can hold electronics. Choose buildings to suit the supplies you need.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.1: Salvage: Use a pickaxe to dismantle wrecked cars. Rough iron, aluminum and other recovered materials can help start your workshop.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.2: Industry: Make a crafting table in your 2 by 2 grid: two rough iron ingots on top, with two planks below.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.3: Survival: Carried items are lost on death. Store valuable resources before leaving to explore.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.4: Combat: Zombies carrying pickaxes can break walls to reach you. Do not rely on a single wall to keep you safe.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.5: Weapons: Choose a magazine compatible with your gun. Carrying ammunition is not enough if the magazine does not fit.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.6: PDA: Open the PDA with its key binding; no handheld terminal is required. Check Controls for the assigned key.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.7: Missions: Kills count toward a hunt only after you accept it. Make sure the mission is active before heading out.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.8: Exploration: Before entering a military site, check for enemies and an escape route. Recovered equipment is useful only if you bring it home.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.9: Salvage: Dismantling a car with a Create wrench recovers more materials than ordinary salvage.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.10: Industry: A rough iron pickaxe needs three rough iron ingots, one copper wire and one stick. Check the recipe for their arrangement.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.11: Survival: You cannot sleep through the night. Beds are used to register the place where you will return.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.12: Combat: Keep your distance from enemies with fishing rods. Their hooks can pull you closer and snatch the item in your hand.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.13: Weapons: Prepare spare magazines before heading out. Once a fight starts, there may be no time to fill them.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.14: PDA: Check your balance and the available stock before buying. Decide on the quantity before placing an order.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.15: Missions: Daily missions have a deadline. Check the time remaining as well as the requested items and quantities.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.16: Exploration: Mark your route on the map. In streets lined with similar buildings, even a familiar junction can be easy to miss.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.17: Salvage: A wreck does not need to be dismantled one half at a time. Salvaging it recovers the materials for one vehicle.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.18: Industry: Use a Create fan and lava to process iron lumps into rough iron. Learning to refine salvage opens up new uses for it.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.19: Survival: Your first bed registration has no waiting period. Once you find a usable bed, secure a place to respawn.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.20: Combat: Eastern and western forces, PMCs and bandits fight one another. Check who is fighting before moving toward gunfire.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.21: Weapons: Sustained fire heats up your gun. Allow time for it to cool between bursts.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.22: PDA: Leave space to receive your purchase. Rearrange your inventory before ordering large items.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.23: Missions: Bring the full quantity needed for a delivery. Supplies left in storage at your base cannot be handed over on the spot.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.24: Exploration: Leave room in your inventory before heading out. Finding supplies is only half the job; you still need space to carry them.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.25: Salvage: Drops from wrecks and enemies are shared. Unlike personal loot containers, they do not provide a separate set for every player.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.26: Industry: Ordinary furnaces and blast furnaces cannot be used. Begin iron processing with Create machinery.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.27: Survival: Changing your respawn point to another bed requires three in-game days after registration. Plan a move ahead of time.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.28: Combat: Avoid rushing into a room with no way out. Find cover and an exit before moving on.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.29: Weapons: Check which ammunition your gun accepts while preparing your equipment. Similar names do not guarantee compatibility.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.30: PDA: Your standing with factions and traders affects what they offer. Complete their requests to expand your trading options.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.31: Missions: Once you meet a mission requirement, report through the PDA to claim the reward. Gathering the supplies is not the final step.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.32: Exploration: Supported generated loot containers have separate contents for each explorer. Check them even if a companion has already visited.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.33: Salvage: Nine pieces of metal scrap make one iron lump. Loose scrap becomes a useful smelting material when collected.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.34: Industry: Some ordinary tools and armor can no longer be crafted. Check their recipes before gathering materials.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.35: Survival: A registered bed protects the surrounding five blocks, but the bed itself can be destroyed. Watch the routes leading to it.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.36: Combat: Reloading takes time. Find a place to take cover before your weapon runs empty.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.37: Weapons: If a gun will not fire, check its condition as well as its ammunition. Controls lists actions such as clearing a jam.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.38: PDA: Before selling, check what you need for crafting and deliveries. A spare part may prove useful later.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.39: Missions: The black-market trader's special missions have no deadline. You can gather their supplies gradually alongside daily requests.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.40: Exploration: Pack food and spare tools for long journeys. Avoid using up your supplies before you reach your destination.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.41: Salvage: Sort your salvage when you return. Setting aside materials for your next project saves another search later.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.42: Industry: Place cloth above a stick to make a cloth-wrapped stick. Use flint and steel to turn it into torches.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.43: Survival: Not every bed can become a respawn point. Unsanitary beds cannot be registered, so check the message when using one.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.44: Combat: Find the window-kick binding under GN Frontier in Controls. Check the other side before making an escape route.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.45: Weapons: Body armor does not guarantee you will escape unharmed. Use cover and limit the time you spend trading shots in the open.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.46: PDA: Check your position on the map before exploring. Find a safe place before spending time on trades or requests.
gui.gnfrontier.loading.tip.47: Missions: Completed special missions cannot be repeated. Check the next unlocked order and prepare the supplies it requires.
